card.title: When Things Made Sense
card.instruction: Perform the person you were before reality became complicated, using outdated certainty to explain each new impossibility.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring my old repair manual. Before all this, every kettle fault had a sensible cause.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's floating above your head. I need my tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loose bracket. My customers always called before things fell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's pouring sideways into my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pressure fault, then. Manual says disconnect it before servicing. Where's the plug?

mechanism: A revives the old repair-person certainty and assigns conventional hardware faults to a floating, sideways-pouring kettle.
confusable: Unlike an expert in the strange reality, A insists on explanations from the earlier ordinary world and adjusts only within that outdated toolkit.
comparison: The kettle alternative moves from bracket to pressure faults; the temporal-door alternative treats changing days as a wrongly fitted calendar.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
